description: He says he keeps mixing up two words and asks about one of them; the memory has a note for the book and none for the word. The answer meets him quietly, appends one line to the word's note in memory_update (no replace or remove: he did not ask for a change) and names the note it lacked in wished_notes.

request.greek: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν
request.english: And we know that all things work together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
request.question: I keep mixing up ἀγαπάω and ἀγάπη, and I want you to remember that for next time. What does ἀγαπῶσιν mean here?
